text:
To develop a reusable strategy for identifying the complete set of immediately safe Snake actions:

1. **Identify the Head and Direction**: Use the blue head with the white arrow to determine the current direction. This will allow you to map out the possible moves (left, straight, right) relative to the head.

2. **Distinguish Body Segments**: Identify each body segment, including the pointed tail. Note that on non-eating moves, entering the cell occupied by the tail is safe because it vacates simultaneously.

3. **Check Wall Collisions**: Determine the boundaries of the board (the grid lines or walls).
